name: Simple Map Locator
author: hamjaiu

sections.description:
This plugin is a simple map store locator plugin. It uses the Leaflet Maps API to display a map
and a marker on the map. The marker is placed at the location of the store. The map can be customized by changing the map type, zoom level, and map style. The plugin also includes a search bar that allows users to search for stores by name or location. The search
bar uses the leaflet Places API to suggest locations as the user types. When a store is
selected, the map zooms in to the location of the store and a marker is placed on the
map. The plugin also includes a map info window
that can be customized by changing the info window content and the info window title.

See a quicke demo of the plugin here: https://hamjaiu.com/simple-map-locator/

Contributors

Amir Hamja, CEO and Co-founder of Hamja Innovative Unix
Developed by IK Robin

Features include:

  • Manage an unlimited numbers of stores.
  • Provide extra details for stores, such as phone, fax, email, URL, and description.
  • Support for custom Map Features.
  • Configurable search zoom, click zoom, and default zoom levels.
  • Search for specific locations
  • Set default latitude and longitude for Google Maps.
  • Search directions by zip code, city, state, and country.
  • Customize the default zoom level from the admin panel set max zoom to see close view.
  • Draggable markers for easy location adjustment.
  • API key not required: Use the shortcode [ikr_leflet_map] to place the map on any page.
  • Customize map Width and Height
  • Default latitude and Longitude (center point)
  • Customizable map marker and popup text
  • Add custom markers
  • Add Custom marker detail popups
  • Edit marker popup text directly from map
  • Delete a marker or marker popup on click the marker you want

Shortcodes

[ikr_leflet_map]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Simple map store Locator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the map to a page with this shortcode: [ikr_leflet_map]
sections.faq:
How do I add the store locator to a page?

Add this shortcode [ikr_leflet_map] to the page where you want to display the store locator.

Can I use different markers for category or individual store locations?

Yes, you can use different markers for individual store locations. To do this, you need to find the store locations and add new markers from the dashboard.

The map doesn’t display properly. It’s either broken in half or doesn’t load at all.

Make sure you have defined a start point for the map under Settings -> Map Settings.
